row.body: I saved the cloth with sticky pollen for you. The orchard spray test crew passed the late afternoon; the mare refused her feed, and afterward the bridge was blocked.
row.title: the late afternoon — sticky pollen

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same sticky pollen while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
